caption: Step by Step School v. Philadelphia Indemnity Insurance Co.
citation_line: Step by Step School v. Philadelphia Indemnity Insurance Co., No. 2:23-cv-02324, ECF No. 38 (D.N.J. Dec. 19, 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Awarded $7,779.12 under Rule 37 after four noticed depositions failed to proceed, but declined case-ending relief and other requested sanctions as disproportionate.
qualification_rationale: A measured sanctions decision illustrating documentation of fees and the preference for a proportionate remedy short of terminating sanctions.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive sanctions order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Monetary discovery sanction short of claim, defense, evidentiary-preclusion, or case-ending relief.
